Package gamerules

Class Board

java.lang.Object
gamerules.Board
public class Board
extends java.lang.Object
Keeps track of player turns, the current board state and the state of the game (has it ended? did anyone win?)

    • requestMoveAndContinue

      public boolean requestMoveAndContinue()
      calls the Player.returnMove(Board) method of the currentPlayer() and ends the turn after the move is executed. If Player.returnMove(Board) returns an invalid move or null, the turn will not be ended
      Returns:
      true if the turn ended as a result of this call

    • forceRequestMoveAndContinue

      public void forceRequestMoveAndContinue()
      Keeps requesting Player.returnMove(Board) from the currentPlayer() until a valid move is returned, then executes the move and ends this turn.

      If the currentPlayer() is a DeterministicReturn object, this will only request a move once and execute forceEndTurn() if the given move is null or invalid.

      private BoardNode[] constructNodes()
